Fitter Function for Systems IVX Models

Source: R/ivx-sys.R
ivx_sys_fit.Rd

Basic function called by ivx_sys. Should only be used directly by experienced users.

Usage

ivx_sys_fit(y, x, horizon = 1, beta = 0.95, cz = 1, bandwidth = NULL, ...)

Arguments

y

numeric response matrix (observations in rows).

x

design matrix of dimension n * p.

horizon

is the horizon (default horizon = 1 corresponds to a short-horizon regression). For horizon > 1 the estimator and modified Wald statistic are those of Kostakis et al. (2023), eqs (15) and (23): K-period sums of the response and of the lagged predictors, a single-lag instrument in the signal matrix and the K-period sum of the instrument in the covariance.

beta, cz

tuning parameters of the IVX instrument \(z_t = \sum_{j=0}^{t-1} (1 - c_z/n^eta)^j \Delta x_{t-j}\). Defaults (beta = 0.95, cz = 1) follow Kostakis et al. (2015).

bandwidth

Newey-West bandwidth for the long-run covariance estimate. The default NULL uses \(n^{1/3}\) as in Kostakis et al. (2015).

...

currently disregarded.

Examples

ivx_sys_fit(as.matrix(kms[, c("Ret", "DE")]), as.matrix(kms[, c("DP", "TBL")]))
